name: ais-group-design
description: AIS Group Design: the brand guide as skills, and a studio that makes on-brand posts, carousels, brochures, catalogues, datasheets and decks from your photos and a short brief.

mediaLibrary.title: Media library folder
mediaLibrary.description: Optional. A folder for the brand photos and videos; leave empty to keep them in the cache, downloaded on demand.

designToken.title: Design MCP token
designToken.description: Optional. The access token of the AIS design server (design.aisgroup.ai/mcp), for AIS staff; it is kept in your system keychain. The skills work without it.
